overview_description.description: Rupa Health is a telehealth solution that makes it easier to practice root-cause medicine. It simplifies lab test ordering and management, integrating with lab companies. Their platform allows effortless ordering, tracking, and billing with EHR integration, supporting both in-person and telehealth patients. The company is involved in custom lab bundles, flexible payment options, and robust practitioner and patient support to enhance efficiency and care.

about_short_description.short_description: Rupa Health is a telehealth solution that makes it easier to practice root cause medicine.

product.name: Lab Test Ordering Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that enables healthcare practitioners to order, track, and manage specialty lab tests from multiple lab companies in one dashboard without needing pre-existing lab accounts.

product.name: Practitioner and Patient Support Services
product.description: Support services that assist practitioners and patients with lab account setup, specimen issues, order management, phlebotomy coordination, and test completion guidance.

product.name: Custom Lab Bundles
product.description: A feature allowing practitioners to create, save, and reorder personalized bundles of lab tests from multiple providers with a single click.

product.name: EHR Integration
product.description: Integration with electronic health record systems to submit lab orders and receive results directly within the patient's medical chart.

product.name: LabShops
product.description: A service that allows practitioners to create personalized storefronts to offer lab testing services to their communities.

product.name: Blood Lab Dashboards
product.description: Customizable dashboards that automatically display and organize patients' blood lab results for enhanced client experience.
